title: VTC Boards — Facilitators — List — payload
description: A facilitator of a board reads who is appointed to facilitate it (VTI-BRD-093). The outer document members are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

Response.title: VTC Boards — Facilitators — List — response payload
Response.description: The success response to a vtc/boards/facilitators/list/0.1 request. Carried in a Trust Task document whose type is https://trusttasks.org/spec/vtc/boards/facilitators/list/0.1#response. The board's appointed facilitators.

facilitators.description: The board's appointments, by entry, oldest first. Holders of `vtc.boards.manage` unqualified or through a role are not listed: they facilitate every board.

Appointment.title: Appointment
Appointment.description: One member's appointment to facilitate the board: a resource grant of `vtc.boards.manage` qualified to it.

appointedAt.description: When the grant was written, or last re-affirmed under a new granter.

appointedBy.description: The granter, by entry. Absent when the granter holds no directory entry — an administrator who is not a member, or one who has departed.

reviewEndsAt.description: Present while the appointment is under review because its granter departed or no longer facilitates the board: it is withdrawn at this time unless an administrator who facilitates the board re-affirms it (VTI-BRD-092).
